title: Finish docs and release readiness
description:
Finish release readiness: README section for the meter; a wiki page under project/wiki/ summarizing the feature (wiki Markdown is directly editable per The Way); note the engines bump if the SQLite decision required one; ensure conventional commits map story/bug/chore work to feat/fix/chore release categories per the semantic-release flow.

Done when: docs are merged, the wiki page exists, lint and coverage pass, and the feature is shippable from develop.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Docs work DONE: README 'Sentiment meter' section (usage, sources, rolling/calendar windows, privacy invariants, config precedence, engines note: node:sqlite reader requires Node >= 22.5) and wiki page project/wiki/coding-session-sentiment-meter.md indexed from index.md. Build clean, lint back to the single pre-existing benchmark error. LEAVING OPEN: the task's 'Done when' includes the accuracy gate KDATAP-713a0f (real-corpus recall on Ryan's Macs) and the semantic-release flow runs on merge — closing this before the gate has evidence would be premature. Remaining after gate passes: confirm conventional-commit mapping (feat for the meter itself, test/chore for guards and Kanbus bookkeeping) in the release merge.
